column6: Salina Sun dated 2026-06-16 reports North Sevier Chamber named Springer Turner Funeral Home Business of the Quarter; the wiki listing points at city hall, but the live chamber work is North Sevier Chamber monthly recognition.
Utah Money Watch 2026-01-26 lists Tuesday Feb 3 2026 Utah Start-up All-Stars Pitch Night produced by SLC Angels and others at Pelion; official slcangels.org itself has no current-cycle date.
Official Annual Meeting page schedules the 2026 Awards Luncheon for August 25 2026 at Loveland Living Planet Aquarium with named honorees.
Offices.co SLC listings page and individual building pages have no dates; searches found no dated update, fee schedule, or news showing the directory is still being maintained; a 200 is not a signal.
Official Mill calendar lists Starting Your Business 101 on December 16 2025 and still shows upcoming August Vibe Code Club and 1 Million Cups sessions hosted at The Mill.

South Valley Chamber June 16 2026 release quotes David Edmunds as founder of Salt Mine Productive Workspace and co-chair of its small-business committee; homepage still bills 2025 Small Business of the Year.
Startup State June 13 2025 reports the revived chamber is accepting members with a new website and dues; memberships page lists current $120/$75/$50 tiers but no dated event calendar was found.

March 3 2026 commission agenda has ED manager Talia Hansen items for 2026 Rural County Grant recipient MOUs and the 2026 Business Basecamp conference; the sjcutaheconomicdevelopment.com site is an undated placeholder.
Official homepage dated June 4 2026 recaps a chamber talk by Dr. Roland Christensen and lists a UK chamber tour for September 2026; April 6 2026 presentation also posted.
Savory Fund April 18 2026 post schedules 8th annual Restaurantology this September with Christina Tosi; January 7 2026 NRN reprint named Clay Dover CEO.

Last official SBA cycle is the archived April 13 2023 application (deadline April 30 2023); current sba.gov Thrive URLs 404 or redirect to generic counseling, and sbathrive.com now hosts unrelated casino content. No 2025 or 2026 cohort found. RUBRIC-GAP: program pages vanished without a sunset notice.
Utah District upcoming-events lists the Utah SBDC Employer Tax Workshop on Sep 17; Tax Commission page confirms Thursday September 17 2026. Office also lists an Aug 26 SBA mitigation session.

SCORE Utah chapter page lists an online live event July 28 2026 10:00 am MDT and Start SMART at 510 W 800 S Cedar City; direct fetches were Cloudflare-blocked so this is from the retrieved official listing.

Utah Business May 20 2026 quotes ED director Malcolm Nash on trail infrastructure and 2026-2027 path miles; wiki Website scedc.com is the Tennessee Sevier County EDC, Utah work is on sevieredc.com and sevier.utah.gov.

AP/NewMediaWire Sept 3 2025: Tidwell and Dahl launched Run Ventures $290M fund from the Signal Peak partnership; work continues under the new brand (ruling 3). Copyright year on run.vc is not a signal.
Clint Betts Jan 29 2026 newsletter promotes SUMMIT 2026 speakers and Feb 18 Dinner Club; main siliconslopes.com timed out (probe 403).

990-EZ for FY ending Dec 2024 filed Sept 29 2025 reports the org operated a school; site newsworthy page stops in 2023 and upcoming-events lists an undated sold-out spring concert. No 2026 concert date found.
Utah Public Notice agenda for R6 Executive Board May 6 2026 at 82 E 600 N Richfield includes FY27 budget and Central Utah Agri-Park master plan; site r6.utah.gov is an undated CMS shell.
GRIT competitions page lists SnowDown March 26 2026 ($12k), Everyday Entrepreneur finals Feb 19 2026, and Bootstrap Your Business Feb 5 2026; snow.edu GRIT page still shows April 2023 deadlines.
990-PF for FY ending Dec 2024 filed Nov 18 2025 shows $4.9M charitable disbursements and paid investment staff; foundation homepage still leads with 2023 PRI posts and a 2023 impact report.
Enoch City Council minutes July 1 2026 record CEO Todd Brightwell presenting SoUtah as a five-county 501(c)(6) with membership, municipal, and state-grant funding; homepage itself has no dates.
Utah Public Notice: SEUALG/SEUEDD executive boards met July 16 2026 at the SERDA building including RLF board, CEDS update, and FY27 grants; serda.utah.gov homepage has no dates.

SERDA community-development page lists 2026 CDBG awards (San Juan, Monticello, Clawson, plus SEUALG admin/planning/housing) and 2026 CIB county lists; duplicate of the live SERDA org. Same July 16 2026 board also ran CEDS/RLF.
Official site schedules Code Camp 2026 Friday Nov 13 to Saturday Nov 14 at Vasion Tech Ridge with Pre-Flight Thursday Nov 12 2026 and an open sponsor ask.

Last dated SUU artifact is October 2023 Hive accelerator coverage; suu.edu/regional/bic and innovationcenter.cc load with undated copy and an empty Upcoming Events block. No opened 2025-2026 cohort or fee schedule.
